description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useShouldBeDisabledDueToPrefill' that determines if a form field should be disabled based on prefilled values, URL query parameters, and form state. It includes utility functions for value comparison and error message parsing.

methods.name: getFieldNameFromErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts the field name from an error message string using regex.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings into an array of strings.

methods.name: intersected
methods.description: Checks if two string arrays have any common elements.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Determines if the search parameter value and form value are equivalent, considering array and string types.

methods.name: useShouldBeDisabledDueToPrefill
methods.description: Main hook that returns a boolean indicating if a form field should be disabled based on prefill logic.

methods.name: isValueSet
methods.description: Checks if a value (string or array) is non-null, defined, and non-empty.

methods.name: hasValidRadioInputValue
methods.description: Validates if a radio input value is consistent with its options.
